title: Identity lifecycle hazards in workload federation policies
hypothesis: A trust policy authorizing mutable or reusable identity names without equivalent stable-ID restrictions can map a distinct post-lifecycle workload to the previously trusted cloud principal.
null_hypothesis: Only the intended stable workload maps to the principal before and after the tested lifecycle events.
novelty_review: known-class local mechanism study; exhaustive survey pending

tool.name: OIDC trust-policy lifecycle auditor
tool.status: local prototype implemented; production adapter pending

local_hypothesis: A valid issuer and audience combined with a reusable repository name can map a replacement identity to the intended cloud principal; stable repository and owner IDs avoid that mapping in the declared fixture model.
hypothesis_evaluation: Constructed local mechanism supported; implementation-level and population claims not established.
